# Earl Co

> Earl Co is a builder, operator, and investor working where dependable AI infrastructure, real-world assets, and long-term ownership meet.

## Canonical information

- Website: https://earlv.co/
- Contact: earlco@nyu.edu
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/earlco
- Current work: https://tekiz.ai

## Areas of work

- TEKIZ.AI: agentic control-plane infrastructure with clear operational boundaries.
- Independent hospitality: technology-enabled operations around memorable real-world places.
- Ownership infrastructure: research into capital, governance, and participation around tangible value.

## Principles

- Systems over hacks
- Ownership over extraction
- Evidence over theatre
- Long-term optionality
